title: Mulaney
executive_producers: Lorne MichaelsJohn MulaneyAndy AckermanAndy SingerDave BeckyDavid MinerJon Pollack
premise_summary: Mulaney is an American sitcom that aired on Fox from October 5, 2014, to February 15, 2015. Stand-up comedian and former Saturday Night Live writer John Mulaney created the show and starred as a fictionalized version of himself. At the beginning of each episode, and sometimes throughout, Mulaney performed stand-up comedy to the studio audience. The show suffered from low ratings and poor critical reviews, and was cancelled in February 2015.
